report.note: formUrl is a placeholder: replace it with the real form address (Google Form prefilled link, Typeform, …). The engine appends lesson, build, version and url as GET parameters using the names in `params`. If formUrl is empty and email is set, a mailto: link is used instead.

changelog.title: Navigation and trust
items: Three learning paths (new to the line, process technologist, inspector) with their own progress and a next-in-path link on every lesson.
Course version and change log on the About page and in the sidebar; build hash shown next to the version.
Report an error link on every lesson and case, carrying the lesson id, version and build.
Print stylesheet: a lesson prints as a clean document with a version footer; quizzes and navigation stay on screen.
Keyboard and contrast audit (scripts/check-a11y.js): zoomable figures operable from the keyboard, all colour pairs at or above WCAG AA.

changelog.title: Images without standards designations
items: All 92 lesson illustrations re-checked by OCR; standards-body designations and logos removed from the images (lesson text still names its sources).
Alt texts of two illustrations reworded to match.

changelog.title: Illustration audit
items: 56 reference-sheet illustrations regenerated, 27 kept, 9 numeric figures replaced by inline SVG drawn from the lesson's own numbers.

changelog.title: Editorial pass and reference pages
items: All 92 lessons rewritten; key takeaways, common mistakes and terms per lesson; reading time from the text.
Glossary (309 terms) and formula sheet (11 relations) derived from the lessons.
Four technologist reviews closed; corrections listed inside the affected lessons.

changelog.title: Toolkit templates
items: Six downloadable forms (18 files) with formulas verified by a spreadsheet engine.

changelog.title: Toolkit cases
items: 15 scored cases on one fictional product (Board X), each with data files, generated keys and a rubric.
